Printed edition: A modest proposal for preventing the children of poor people from being a burthen to their parents, or the country, and for making them beneficial to the publick.  1729, 1729, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bim_eighteenth-century_a-modest-proposal-for-pr_swift-jonathan_1729.
